testCases.title: Catalog Search Returns Filtered Results by Keyword
testCases.failedAssertion: [ASSERT] response body totalCount = 0 for nonexistent keyword
networkErrors: POST /api/catalog/search/products → 200 but totalCount=9165 (same as no filter)
testCases.notes: POST /api/catalog/search/products with keyword=nonexistent_xyz_qqq returns HTTP 200 totalCount=9165, identical to a valid keyword search for 'laptop'. The keyword filter parameter appears to be ignored — search returns all catalog products regardless of keyword value.

testCases.title: Inventory Reserve Endpoint Available
testCases.notes: Endpoint /api/inventory/products/{productId}/reserve does not exist (404). The documented reserve endpoint is not present in Platform 3.1037.0. Inventory availability queries work via GET /api/inventory/products/{productId} but reserve is not available via REST.

testCases.title: Cart REST API — Add Item to Cart
testCases.notes: Cart REST API does not exist in this deployment. Cart operations are GraphQL-only via /graphql (addItem mutation). All cart-related REST endpoints (API-010, API-020, API-021, API-022) are BLOCKED for the same reason.

testCases.title: Order API Returns 404 for Nonexistent Order
testCases.notes: GET /api/order/customerOrders/nonexistent-id-xyz returns HTTP 200 with body null instead of 404 Not Found. The platform silently returns null for unknown order IDs rather than a proper not-found error response.

testCases.title: Catalog Product Create Returns 400 for Invalid Body
testCases.failedAssertion: [ASSERT] HTTP 400 with validation errors for empty product body
testCases.notes: POST /api/catalog/products with empty body {} returns HTTP 500 with message 'Validation failed: -- CatalogId must not be empty...'. Should return HTTP 400 Bad Request with structured validation errors, not 500. Stacktrace is null but status code is incorrect.

testCases.title: Pagination — Negative Skip Returns 400
networkErrors: POST /api/catalog/search/products with skip=-1 → 500 Internal Server Error (expected 400)
testCases.notes: POST /api/catalog/search/products with {skip:-1, take:10} returns HTTP 500 with Elasticsearch error: 'illegal_argument_exception: [from] parameter cannot be negative'. Should return HTTP 400 with validation error before hitting the search backend.

testCases.title: Pagination — Skip Beyond ES Window Returns 400
testCases.failedAssertion: [ASSERT] HTTP 400 or graceful error for skip beyond ES 10000 limit
networkErrors: POST /api/catalog/search/products with skip=999999 → 500 Internal Server Error
testCases.notes: POST /api/catalog/search/products with {skip:999999, take:10} returns HTTP 500: 'Result window is too large, from + size must be less than or equal to: [10000]'. The Elasticsearch 10000-result window limit is exposed directly as a 500 to the client without graceful handling.

testCases.title: Pagination — Non-Numeric / Invalid Params Return 400
networkErrors: POST /api/catalog/search/products with skip=abc,take=xyz → 500 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'
testCases.notes: All invalid pagination parameter combinations return HTTP 500. Negative values trigger Elasticsearch errors; non-numeric values cause a NullReferenceException. None return the expected HTTP 400 with structured validation messages.

testCases.title: Large Batch Request Returns 400 or Partial Results (Not 5xx)
testCases.failedAssertion: [ASSERT] take=10000 returns 400 or bounded response, not 5xx
testCases.notes: Requests with very large take values result in gateway-level errors (502/524) from Cloudflare rather than application-level 400s. take=1000 succeeds (200, 1000 items). take=10000 hits the ES result window limit and results in a 502. Orders with take=5000 causes a connection timeout (524). Platform should validate and cap take parameter before forwarding to backend.

testCases.title: OPTIONS Preflight Returns 200 with CORS Headers
networkErrors: OPTIONS /api/catalog/products → 405 Method Not Allowed (no CORS headers)
testCases.notes: OPTIONS preflight request to /api/catalog/products returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed. No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is present. CORS is handled at CDN (Cloudflare) level — the cross-origin-resource-policy: cross-origin header is set but standard CORS preflight flow is not supported at the app layer. Browser-based cross-origin requests from the storefront rely on CDN-level CORS pass-through, not app-level OPTIONS handling.

testCases.title: CORS Preflight on Auth Endpoint
networkErrors: OPTIONS /connect/token → 400 Bad Request (no CORS headers, expected 200/204 preflight)
testCases.notes: OPTIONS request to /connect/token returns 400 Bad Request instead of a proper preflight 200/204 response with CORS headers. Same root cause as API-031: CORS is handled at CDN level, not at application layer. /connect/token treats OPTIONS as a malformed token request.

bugs.title: Catalog keyword search ignores keyword parameter — returns all products regardless of input
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Obtain admin token via POST /connect/token. 2. POST /api/catalog/search/products with body {"keyword":"nonexistent_xyz_qqq","take":10}. 3. Check response totalCount.
bugs.actual: HTTP 200, totalCount = 9165, items = 10 products (identical to search with no keyword filter)

bugs.title: Order GET by nonexistent ID returns HTTP 200 null instead of 404
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Obtain admin token. 2. GET /api/order/customerOrders/nonexistent-id-xyz. 3. Check response status.

bugs.title: Catalog product create with invalid body returns HTTP 500 instead of 400
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Obtain admin token. 2. POST /api/catalog/products with body {}. 3. Check response status.
bugs.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with JSON validation error array
bugs.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error, body: {"message":"Validation failed: -- CatalogId must not be empty...","stackTrace":null}

bugs.title: Pagination validation not enforced — invalid/negative/out-of-range values cause HTTP 500
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Obtain admin token. 2. POST /api/catalog/search/products with any of: {skip:-1,take:10}, {skip:999999,take:10}, {skip:-999,take:-1}, {skip:"abc",take:"xyz"}, {take:10000}. 3. Check response status.
bugs.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with validation message before reaching Elasticsearch
bugs.actual: HTTP 500 (ES illegal_argument_exception for negative skip; ES result window exceeded for large skip; NullReferenceException for non-numeric; 502/524 gateway errors for extreme take values)

bugs.title: OPTIONS preflight returns 405 — CORS not handled at app layer
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Send OPTIONS /api/catalog/products with Origin: https://vcst-qa-storefront.govirto.com, Access-Control-Request-Method: GET. 2. Check response status and CORS headers.
bugs.expected: HTTP 200 or 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers
bugs.actual: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed; no CORS headers. CORS is handled by Cloudflare CDN (cross-origin-resource-policy: cross-origin present) but OPTIONS preflight is not handled by the platform application.
bugs.notes: May be by-design if CORS is fully delegated to the CDN. Needs architecture review before confirming.
